CARD.UPCOMING: No meetings booked | 1 meeting booked | {count} meetings booked

CARD.CONFIRM_DELETE: Delete this page? The link will stop working.

LINK.OPEN_LABEL: Open the page in a new tab

ERRORS.TITLE: Write the name the client sees.
ERRORS.LINK: Paste the full link, starting with https://
ERRORS.HOURS: The end time must be after the start time.
ERRORS.IMAGE_TYPE: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
ERRORS.IMAGE_SIZE: The image can be up to 2 MB.
ERRORS.IMAGE_UPLOAD: We couldn't upload the image. Try another one.

SERVER_ERRORS.CALENDAR_GONE: That calendar email inbox is no longer available. Choose another one or remove Google Meet and Teams.
SERVER_ERRORS.PEOPLE_GONE: Someone you chose can no longer take meetings. Choose again.
SERVER_ERRORS.LOCATIONS: One of the places can no longer be used. Check where the conversation happens.
SERVER_ERRORS.PIPELINE: That pipeline or stage no longer exists. Choose another one.
SERVER_ERRORS.BRAND: Check the color and the welcome message.
SERVER_ERRORS.NOTICE_INBOX_GONE: This WhatsApp can no longer send notices. Choose another one or leave it without notices.
SERVER_ERRORS.NOTICE_TEMPLATES: One of the approved messages does not work: it needs the booking link. Choose another one.
SERVER_ERRORS.NOTICES: Check the notices and the deadline to change.

NOTICES.TITLE: WhatsApp notices
NOTICES.INTRO: The customer gets a message with the day, the time and a link to confirm, change or cancel. Every message has a way to stop receiving them.
NOTICES.NO_INBOXES: No connected WhatsApp can send notices yet. When there is one, it shows up here.

CHANNEL.OFFICIAL: This is the official WhatsApp. If the customer has not talked to you in the last 24 hours, the notice only goes out with a message approved by Meta. Choose those messages below.
CHANNEL.WAHA: From this number, the notice only goes out if the customer talked to you in the last 24 hours. This keeps the number safe from being blocked.
CHANNEL.API: From this number, the notice goes out when the customer talked to you in the last 24 hours.

NOTICES.PRESET_LABEL: When should the customer be notified?

STANDARD.LABEL: When booked, 1 day before and 1 hour before
STANDARD.SUMMARY: when booked, 1 day before and 1 hour before

MINIMAL.LABEL: Only when booked
MINIMAL.HINT: One message, with the day, the time and the link.

NOTICES.SAMPLE_LABEL: This is what the customer gets
NOTICES.SAMPLE_TEXT:
Hi, Ana! Your time is booked for 10/14 at 3:00 PM. To confirm, change or cancel: chat.example.com/b/AB3K9QXZ
To stop these notices: chat.example.com/b/AB3K9QXZ
NOTICES.TEMPLATES_HINT: Choose an approved message for each notice. To show up here, it needs the booking link in place of {link}. It can use {name} for the customer name and {when} for the day and time.
NOTICES.TEMPLATES_EMPTY: This WhatsApp has no approved message with the booking link yet. Without one, the notice only goes out to people who talked to you in the last 24 hours. Ask whoever manages WhatsApp to create one on Meta.
NOTICES.CANCEL_LABEL: Until when can the customer change or cancel?
NOTICES.CANCEL_HINT: After that, the link shows the time but does not allow changes. The customer then talks to you.

TEST.PHONE_HINT: You get a link just like the customer does. If you book a time with it, the time is really booked.

ERRORS.NO_INBOX: This page has no notices. Choose a WhatsApp in the notices step.
ERRORS.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this WhatsApp. Ask an administrator to run the test.
ERRORS.INVALID_PHONE: Check the number. Include the area code, for example (11) 98888-0000.
ERRORS.OUTSIDE_WINDOW: First send a “hi” from your phone to the company WhatsApp. Then tap Send test again.
ERRORS.NUMBER_CAP: This number already got many messages today. Try tomorrow or use another number.
ERRORS.STOPPED: This number asked not to get messages. Use another number.
ERRORS.CONVERSATION_FORBIDDEN: This number already talks to the company in a conversation you cannot open. Use another number.
ERRORS.CANNOT_SEND: Could not send from this WhatsApp. Check that it is connected.
ERRORS.FAILED: Could not send right now. Try again.

PREVIEW.TITLE: This is what the client will see
PREVIEW.DEFAULT_HEADLINE: Pick the best time to talk
PREVIEW.DESTINATION: Whoever books goes to the {pipeline} pipeline, {stage} stage, with {people}.
PREVIEW.DESTINATION_NO_PIPELINE: Whoever books stays with {people}. No pipeline is chosen yet.

MISSING.PIPELINE: Choose which pipeline new bookings go to

PREVIEW.PUBLISHED_TEXT: Send the link to your clients or show the QR code.
PREVIEW.NOTICES_ON: The customer gets a WhatsApp notice {when}, from the number {inbox}.
PREVIEW.NOTICES_ON_NO_NAME: The customer gets a WhatsApp notice {when}.
PREVIEW.NOTICES_OFF: No WhatsApp notices. The customer sees the time on screen and in their calendar.
PREVIEW.CANCEL_UNTIL: They can change or cancel up to {value} before.
PREVIEW.CANCEL_ANYTIME: They can change or cancel up to the booked time.

VIEW.READ_ONLY: You can see this page, but you can't change it.
